messages:
Maya: quick check — starting onboarding for mpt-7b-variantX. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/mpt-7b/variantX/sha256-9a3f2.pt. planning AWQ + FP8 baseline. anyone seen tokenizer quirks with this export?
Eli: I pulled the tokenizer. Noticed vocab uses byte-level BPE with special token names different from our serving default (we expect <|user|> but file maps it to <usr_tok>). Might break role-ids in chat mode.
Maya: ugh. which tokenizer file path are you using?
Eli: s3://redwood-models/mpt-7b/variantX/tokenizer.json. sample mapping: "<usr_tok>": 50256. Past models used "<|user|>": 50256.
Sam: for serving we can shim with a token_aliases.json to remap. infra has a validation script that flags mismatch.
Maya: can you run the validator and paste output?
Eli: ran it — snippet: 
```
$ python infra/validate_serving_config.py --model s3://redwood-models/mpt-7b/variantX/sha256-9a3f2.pt --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/mpt-7b/variantX/tokenizer.json --quant awq
Result: WARN — tokenizer special token mismatch (user/system).
KV CACHE: OK
MAX_SEQ_LEN: config mismatch (2048 vs 4096) -> WARN
```
Anya: thanks — re: quant: AWQ calibration dataset lives at s3://redwood-calib/mpt-7b/variantX/100k-samples.jsonl (sampling mix: webtext:60%, stack:20%, dialog:20%). FP8 pipeline ready too but needs our regression eval.
Maya: what were the eval deltas? we care about small LM head/regression on chat outputs.
Anya: quick summary from local eval (awq vs fp16):
- Perplexity (wiki + evalmix): AWQ +0.9, FP8 +1.6
- MMLU accuracy: AWQ -0.6%, FP8 -1.4%
- Average response latency (p50 tokens): AWQ ~= 28ms, FP8 ~= 21ms
- Cost per token estimate: AWQ ~0.62x, FP8 ~0.38x relative to fp16
Maya: tradeoffs look reasonable. we need product QA sign-off for <=1% MMLU drop and perf improvements. @Taylor can you weigh in?
Taylor: I can review tomorrow AM. question on the MAX_SEQ_LEN mismatch — does serving allow truncation fallback?
Sam: Serving runtime will error if model config max_seq_len > runtime max_seq_len; we have a fallback that auto-truncates requests > runtime limit but only if config.explicit_truncation=true. validator suggested setting explicit_truncation=true in serving.yaml.
Eli: also note tokenizer remap recommended. I'll add token_aliases.json and re-run validator.
infra-bot: automatic check completed: config.lint -> 2 WARN, 0 ERROR. artifacts: s3://redwood-models/mpt-7b/variantX/serve-manifest.json created.
Maya: thanks infra-bot. Sam / Anya can you push a quick PR with:
- token_aliases.json (map <|user|> -> <usr_tok>)
- serving.yaml update explicit_truncation=true
- quant/awq calib manifest pointing at the 100k file

Sam: will do PR now, pinging reviewers.
Anya: one more note — FP8 quantization requires a slight learning-rate-aware recalibration step for adapters. we should flag in the release notes.
Maya: noted. once PR is in, run full eval on staging and post numbers here. if final MMLU drop <=1% and latency/cost improvements align, I'll request a canary deploy.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled once manual approval received.
Taylor: ACK, will review the eval numbers and sign off if within thresholds.
Maya: thanks all — follow-ups: Eli update validator run; Sam open PR link; Anya run staging eval and paste perf table.
Eli: validator PASS after token_aliases.json + explicit_truncation on serving.yaml.
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/498 — includes alias + serving.yaml + calib manifest.
Anya: staging eval results (AWQ): Perplexity +0.8, MMLU -0.5%, p50 tokens 29ms. FP8: PPL +1.5, MMLU -1.2%, p50 22ms. attaching eval gist: https://gist.github.com/anya/eval-mpt-variantX
Maya: looks good. @Taylor if you give final OK I'll start canary tomorrow morning.
Taylor: OKAY — approve canary. please include release note about FP8 adapter recalibration and tokenizer aliasing. :+1:
Maya: canary scheduled. thanks team :rocket:
